title: fix(cli): show Gateway startup failure reasons without debug
body:
Fixes #172053. Supersedes #172058, thanks @skyzhao1223.

## What Problem This Solves

Failed Gateway starts can print only a generic CLI failure and Doctor hint, leaving service restart loops undiagnosable from their journal.

## User Impact

Unexpected foreground Gateway startup failures now include a redacted `[openclaw] Reason:` without debug mode, including the managed service's `gateway --port <N>` invocation. `gateway status` and `sessions list` retain their terse output; nested causes and stacks remain debug-only.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared CLI failure formatter omitted foreground Gateway starts from its reason policy. Reuse the startup-safe `isForegroundGatewayRunArgv` parser directly so option values are consumed correctly, and render through the existing `formatCliOperatorError` → `formatErrorMessage` redaction path. Remove the obsolete terse-default comment. Production: +2/-2 lines, net 0; tests: +41; docs: +1. No new flags, configuration, dependencies, or stored data.

## Evidence

- Regression on baseline `3427d94223dc1ca4eca74f621710098ac82505e2`: all five startup cases failed specifically because `Reason:` was missing; 31 existing/negative-control tests passed. After repair, `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/failure-output.test.ts --maxWorkers=1` passed all 36 tests (27.88s wrapper wall time). Covers bare/explicit starts, `--port`, `--bind` plus `--port`, root `--profile`, secret redaction, terse sibling commands, and no stack or nested diagnostic.
- Cross-lane importer proof: all 35 selected files passed across seven native Vitest shards: 903 passed, two pre-existing skips. The basename search's Docker output-directory string was excluded because it does not import the formatter. Total wrapper wall time: 2210.71s, including E2E build/ownership preparation; regression-file assertion time: 65ms. Longest individual test: the existing accepted-run transport-loss E2E, 25.575s. CI timing is pending.
- E2E runtime preparation passed in 26m 1.1s; `tsdown` accounted for 25m 25.5s, including 1279.4s of serial workspace package declaration generation. This is compiler/build preparation, separate from test time.
- `node scripts/check-changed.mjs`: every selected check passed except inherited Knip findings in untouched files: `ui/src/components/mcp-server-form.ts: renderMcpServerForm` and `src/daemon/launchd-install.test-support.ts: launchAgentFixture`. Core typechecking, all 28 core test graphs, changed-file lint/format, config docs, ratchets, plugin boundaries, and runtime cycle checks passed. No baseline or suppression changes.
- `node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs scripts/check-madge-import-cycles.ts`: zero cycles. Final formatting and `git diff --check` passed.
- Isolated Codex autoreview: no accepted/actionable P0–P2 findings. The final docs wording clarifies that unexpected failures use this diagnostic and describes how to request stacks.
